references.text: The context of the bells on the hem of the robe, which were to make a sound when Aaron entered and exited the sanctuary
Fulfillment of the command to make bells of pure gold and attach them to the robe between the pomegranates
Warning to Aaron not to enter the sanctuary at any time, so that he would not die
Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord's presence, showing the seriousness of the priestly service
The warning that the Levites must not look upon the holy things without proper preparation, or they would die
Solomon's prayer mentions the principle of serving in the sanctuary before the Lord's presence
Priests had to wash themselves before approaching the altar to perform their duties, so that they would not die
Description of how the high priest entered the Most Holy Place once a year with blood
Both verses emphasize that the holy garments are a condition for life for the priest at the entrance to the sanctuary.
Confirms the same theological principle that proper handling of holy things is a condition for life to avoid death.
Both show how specific parts of the priest's garment ensure his access to the Lord's face without dying.
